context: The November 1, 2026 Ripple escrow event is no longer merely scheduled: a public ledger-derived tracker reports two EscrowFinish transactions at 00:00:02 UTC releasing 1B XRP. The pinned ledger at 00:27 UTC shows no re-escrow yet.
decisions: Represent escrow eligibility, EscrowFinish execution, destination receipt, subsequent transfers, EscrowCreate, exchange deposit, sale and market impact as distinct event states.
Record 1B XRP gross release and 1B XRP net outside escrow only as of ledger 108034152 at 00:27 UTC.
Do not infer a sale, exchange deposit, customer supply or directional price impact from the release.
Retain the 64.2% trailing 12-month re-escrow statistic with its exact Dec 2025-Nov 2026 window and pinned cutoff; it can change if later November EscrowCreate activity occurs.
Require raw transaction metadata and destination decoding before admitting destination or disposition features.
Require synchronized event-time spot depth, trades, ETF creations/redemptions, venue reserves and derivatives snapshots before estimating market impact.
Preserve the prior pre-eligibility and post-eligibility-unverified snapshots as historical evidence; this snapshot supersedes only their current event-status interpretation.
next_action: Retrieve raw public XRPL transaction JSON and account_objects at a newer validated ledger; decode both Destination fields and subsequent account_tx history; monitor EscrowCreate and exchange-tagged transfers; compare synchronized market data only after chain events are verified.
